headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 17, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 14.67%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 9.35%. This translates to an average alpha of 5.32%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the broader market. The top-performing portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 28.63%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 7.91%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, providing a strong signal of relative strength. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
